ctaHeading: Ready for Your Dream Garden in Eastern Suburbs?
aboutText: LandShapes Landscaping boasts two decades of expertise in garden design and maintenance throughout Melbourne's Eastern Suburbs. Under Matt's leadership, our dedicated team delivers comprehensive services from initial clean-ups to intricate landscape designs. We are committed to understanding and exceeding client expectations, ensuring your garden remains vibrant and well-maintained year-round.
servicesText: We offer a full range of landscaping services including clean-ups, landscape design, maintenance, planting, turf laying, and irrigation. Our team is equipped to handle projects of all sizes, ensuring your outdoor space is both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

services.title: Clean Ups
services.desc: Thorough garden clean-ups to remove debris, trim overgrowth, and restore order to your outdoor space.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.desc: Creative and customised landscape designs that transform your garden into a beautiful, functional area.

services.title: Maintenance Services
services.desc: Regular maintenance to keep your garden healthy, tidy, and looking its best throughout the seasons.

services.title: Planting Services
services.desc: Expert planting of trees, shrubs, and flowers to enhance colour and biodiversity in your garden.

services.title: Laying Turf
services.desc: Professional turf laying for lush, green lawns that are durable and easy to maintain.

services.title: Irrigation
services.desc: Efficient irrigation systems installation and maintenance to ensure optimal watering and plant health.

bannerSubheading: We're here to help with all your garden needs.
